title: plastic tubs with handles
text: plastic tubs with handles. These are pretty cheap - the clips and handles are just ok.  They won't carry much weight - but they are too small to carry much.  I switched my plan and am storing really light weight diamond painting supplies in one and some sewing items in the other... You get 4.  As long as you have a very lightweight duty project, they are ok.  NOT for heavyweight items.  The boxes are a frosty clear plastic and the side clips and handles are black plastic.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
